AltLangRelLinksWikis.description: The language wikis of this farm, as language code => wiki ID (database domain), e.g. { "he": "kz_he", "ar": "kz_ar" }. Only these languages get an hreflang alternate. An empty map keeps the legacy behaviour: every interlanguage link of the page, unfiltered, and no hub lookup.

AltLangRelLinksHubLanguage.description: Language code of the hub wiki, whose interlanguage links define the full language set of a page. A page on another language wiki reaches its hub page through its own interlanguage link to the hub language. Must be a key of $wgAltLangRelLinksWikis; null disables the hub lookup.

AltLangRelLinksNamespaces.description: Namespaces whose pages get hreflang alternates. null means the content namespaces ($wgContentNamespaces).

AltLangRelLinksXDefault.description: Whether to add an hreflang="x-default" alternate that points at the hub page.

AltLangRelLinksCanonical.description: Whether to add a <link rel="canonical"> to wiki pages that have none. Has no effect when $wgEnableCanonicalServerLink is on, since core then adds one itself.
